Who we are

We turn complex requirements into buildable, coordinated designs.

Meridian Energy & Engineering Pvt Ltd. is a multi-disciplinary engineering design and consulting partner for process plants, industrial facilities, infrastructure and the built environment. We work as an extension of your team — bringing clarity to scope, discipline to documentation, and practical thinking to every drawing we issue.

Our strength is connecting people, software and site experience. Whether you need a complete design package, a specialist drafted deliverable, or skilled engineers on deputation, we shape the engagement around your standards and schedule.

Design-led thinking

Practical concepts that consider constructability from day one.

Coordinated delivery

One workflow across disciplines, drawings and revisions.

Documentation depth

GA, P&ID, layouts, isometrics, shop drawings and as-builts.

Quality mindset

Internal checks, version control and safety-aware design.

Why teams choose Meridian
Our services

Integrated capabilities, tailored to your project.

Choose a single discipline or a complete project team. Every engagement is scoped around your standards, schedule and deliverables.

Engineering Services

Process, piping, structural and civil design backed by detailed drafting, analysis and construction documentation.

Training & Skill Development

Corporate and individual upskilling in CAD, piping, structural, BIM and industry-standard design workflows.

Digital engineering

2D precision. 3D clarity. One coordinated model.

Our plant design teams build coordinated 3D models and issue-ready drawings using S3D/PDS & E3D/PDMS. We support model reviews, clash detection, piping layouts, isometrics, quantity take-offs and as-built documentation — so key decisions happen before they become site problems.
